page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No marginal notes. Running head at top right, page number at top left, catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: tes illis adjunctas, non exclusis earum pki[?] colloquiis.

Porrò confirmata subjectione mulierum erga maritos, describit etiam ornatum eis convenientem, tanquam partem honestae sanctaeq; conversationis, & boni exempli maritos ad pietatem permoturi. Siquidem non parum momenti habet, qua quis sit veste amictus. Neq; enim temere apud veteres & nostri aevi homines Adagium increbuit, Ex veste aestimari hominem. Unde & Ecclesiasticus cap.19.inquit: Suus cujusq; habitus, aut ristum[?] diducens, rifio[?], incessusq; hominis, quomodo sit animatus arguunt. Credimus enim plerique varii & inconstantioris animi indicium esse vestem varicolorem, corrupti aut lacerandi cupidi laceratam five conscis-sam, arrogantis & impudentis plus nimio exquisitam & procacem. Proinde Petrus adversus muliebrem luxum (quem sibi velut cognatū habens) differit: modestiam & vitae sanctimoniam commendat. Ac primum quidem ostendit, sicut & Paulus 1.Tim.2. à quo fortasis (ut Marloratus ex Bullingero refert) hæc verba mutuatus est Petrus (& quod sanctos Dei viros nunquam puduit, inter sua retulit) ostendit, inquam, qualis non debeat esse ornatus sanctarum matronarum, nempe ille externus nimiusq; in contextu, five cri-spatura capillorum, in preciositate vestitus, & aliorum ornamentorum positus. Certum enim est argumentum, parum admodum

page.notes: Line 1 is a fragment continuing from the previous page. "pki[?]" in the first line is doubtful; the word looks like "phi" or "pli" and I could not read it reliably. "riftum" and "rifio" are doubtful readings: the printed letters appear to be ristum and risio, while the expected text is "risum" and "risu". Long s has been normalised to s throughout, including "conscis-sam", which is a hyphenated line break. The numeral "cap.19." appears printed as "cap.I9." and is copied as 19. "ornametorum" appears to be a printing error for "ornamentorum", left as printed in the spirit of the transcription and corrected only for the vowel/consonant rules.
